name: Bench dip

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Bend your elbows straight back — lower your hips

phases.name: hold
phases.cue: Elbows at about 90°, upper arms level

phases.name: press
phases.cue: Press through your palms to straighten your arms

phases.name: rest
phases.cue: Chest up, shoulders down and back

formTips: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench, hands just beside your hips with the fingers over the edge
Slide your hips forward off the bench and plant your heels with your knees bent
Keep your back close to the bench as you lower straight down
Point your elbows straight back, not out to the sides
Stop when your elbows reach about 90° and your upper arms are level, then press back up
Straighten your legs out in front to make it harder
commonMistakes: Dropping so low that the shoulders sink below the elbows and roll forward
Flaring the elbows out to the sides
Drifting away from the bench so the shoulders take the load
Pushing up with the legs instead of the arms
Shrugging the shoulders up towards the ears
